name: P ZERO Race TLR 4S

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: Pirelli: the P ZERO Race range is made in Italy (Bollate factory).

positioning: Year-round tubeless racing tire with the SmartNET Silica compound for wet grip and mileage.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli describes SmartNET Silica as its best formulation for wet grip, for year-round racing.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; no mainland China listing was checked for this line; North American availability not verified in this pass.

caveats: Heavier and slower-rolling than the standard P ZERO Race TLR in the same lab; measured wet grip was similar (76 versus 75 at 28 mm).
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated on the product page.
